name: Matsuyama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with a green crest of stylised pine boughs and castle.
history: The flag of Matsuyama bears the city's mon (municipal emblem) in the Japanese civic tradition of a single stylised mark on a plain field.

features.role: Matsuyama municipal emblem — a green crest of stylised pine boughs and castle
features.symbolism: the pines (matsu) and hilltop castle of Matsuyama
